quote: Dr. Shahrukh Khan is a highly skilled and professional orthopedic doctor. He listened to my concerns carefully and explained the problem in a very clear and simple way. The treatment was very effective.
author: Yuvi Khan

quote: Really a caring team. Took very good care of my mother's consultation. Highly qualified team of doctors from AIIMS, Max, LNJP and Apollo. They are the best.
author: Kartik Kirti

quote: After a long time I met my classmate Dr. Shahrukh Khan. He is an excellent doctor — simple, superb human being, approachable with a smiling face. Hardly find such non-commercial doctors in this era.
author: Ashutosh Dwivedi
